not_established: BISULFID is the name of this website. The name is not a chemical claim, and this reference does not state that German Bisulfid is the equivalent of English bisulfide. Some German industry pages use Bisulfid for HS⁻, and one was captured verbatim, but an industry page is not an admissible source for terminology here, so that usage is recorded as a boundary and not adopted. The IUPAC Gold Book entry on hydrosulfides could not be retrieved openly when the sources were captured, and a second German teaching handout was unreachable, so neither is cited. Other German dictionaries were not examined for Bisulfid. The history of the bi- prefix, how often each spelling is used, and the safety or industrial properties of any species named here are outside this reference [SOURCE REQUIRED].
